Reset setter copies mapping, sorts times and clears eager post-stop cache; geometry independent of resets, captured native reset applies to already-issued iterator. _zone obtains inherited/gate/carried, registers parent before creating accepted iterator; computes direct route before consuming. Accepted public stream grouped by exact crossing, each group sorted by (cross,-First), merged with direct/inherited/carried in that order; global choice uses different key from accepted stream. limitations: Native exact types, timezone identity and finite Decimal do not establish universal comparability, stable attributes, bounded identities, chronology coherence, or same value/side effects under unusual inputs.

Eager OA53 can include equal indexed confirmation with identity beyond signed 63-bit sentinel or row confirmation inconsistent with index; native strict actual confirmation and coherence gate differ. Native rejects/validates unselected rows on build, while eager may skip them; fallback is synchronous and may read cache. Native null crossing requires cached None rather than recomputing. Caller-context vs localcontext flags/traps, eager exception timing and lazy consumption are not proven equivalent.

Initial conflicting event pairs and initial/audit event conflicts trigger conservative fallback; audit-audit conflicts or index-versus-reaction identity inconsistency are not expressly checked. Equal event pairs can differ in non-key fields. OA53 preserves first insertion rank even after replacement; OA59 selects first merged physical identity. Equal complete audit keys across tiers use run order; stable tie equivalence depends on owner invariants, not claimed for arbitrary malformed data.

Published audit containers are copied/replaced, not deeply immutable; already issued generator captures view and reset, but nested aliases remain mutable. Owner append/rebuild/reset and caller early termination are bounded source observations, not cross-owner certification.
